description.ja: 人とAIの“すれ違い”をテーマに挑む新規SFプロジェクト『SYNDUALITY』が本格始動！
description.en: A new science fiction project “SYNDUALITY” that challenges the theme of “passing each other” between humans and AI has started in earnest!

description.ja: 2023年放送開始予定のTVアニメ『SYNDUALITY』から、主人公カナタが搭乗するメカ「デイジーオーガ」が特徴的な武装や多彩なギミックを搭載し、HGシリーズで最速立体化！
description.en: From the TV anime "SYNDUALITY " scheduled to start broadcasting in 2023, the mecha " Daisy Ogre" piloted by the main character Kanata is equipped with distinctive weapons and various gimmicks, and is the fastest three-dimensional figure in the HG series!

description.ja: ■細部までディテールを造形されたコックピットとコフィンはスライド・オープンギミックを搭載。主人公カナタとノワールのフィギュアが付属し搭乗状態を再現できる。
description.en: • The cockpit and coffin are sculpted with great detail and are equipped with a slide/open gimmick. Figures of the main characters Kanata and Noir are included, allowing you to recreate their riding status.

description.ja: ■ロングタイプのチェーンパーツが付属。差し替えでソーチェーンの射出状態を表現可能。
description.en: • Includes long type chain parts. It is possible to express the injection state of the saw chain by replacing it.

description.ja: ■特徴的な脚部には複数の可動軸を内蔵。劇中の歩行状態、ローラーダッシュ状態を再現できる脚部形態変形用パーツも付属。
description.en: • The unique legs have multiple movable axes. Parts for changing the shape of the legs are also included to recreate the walking and roller dashing states from the movie.

description.ja: ■ディスプレイ台座が付属しアクションポーズをサポート。
description.en: • A display pedestal is included to support action poses.

description.ja: ■印象的なマーキングを再現できるシールが付属。アイセンサーシールの選択で様々な表情演出が可能。
description.en: • Comes with a seal that can reproduce impressive markings. Various facial expressions are possible by selecting the eye sensor Seal.

accessories.ja: ソーチェーン差し替え用パーツ×１
スモークディスチャージャー×１
脚部形態変形用パーツ×1式
accessories.en: Leg shape transformation parts x 1 set

accessories.ja: フィギュア×２種(カナタ、ノワール)
